paper_title: Stronger limits on hypothetical Yukawa interactions in the 30-8000 nm range
notes: Fifth-force/Yukawa search: V(r)=-G m1 m2/r * alpha * exp(-r/lambda). Headline result is the red "IUPUI (2014)" observed exclusion curve in Fig.4 (lambda-alpha plane), digitised from the vector Fig4.pdf in the arXiv e-print. Native variables kept: y=|alpha| (Yukawa strength relative to gravity), x=boson mass in eV converted from Compton range via m=1.97e-7 eV*m/lambda(m). Axis calibration from major tick strokes (lambda: 128.8px/decade, alpha: 20.92px/decade), cross-checked against decade labels. Curve spans lambda ~ 3e-8 to 2e-5 m (mass ~6.6 to 0.010 eV), which is the paper stated 30-8000 nm improvement range. Limit at 95% CL per text. ScalarNucleon plane (scalar coupling to nucleons); reported in native alpha-vs-lambda as allowed by task card for fifth-force papers.
